name: FND_NTF_NOTIFICATION
description: Entity for persisting the notification pertaining to the business event.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_ID
columns.description: Primary identifier of the entity.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the fnd_ntf_event table.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: Alias or any unique identifier for the recipient within the ApplicationModule.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the fnd_ntf_recipient table.

columns.name: CHANNEL_TYPE
columns.description: The name for the channel as registered in fnd_ntf_channel table.

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: The users unique and personal delivery address in this channel.

columns.name: PROPERTY1
columns.description: Additional property field for expansion.

columns.name: PROPERTY2
columns.description: Additional property field for expansion.

columns.name: PROPERTY3
columns.description: Additional property field for expansion.

columns.name: PROPERTY4
columns.description: Additional property field for expansion.

columns.name: PROPERTY5
columns.description: Additional property field for expansion.

columns.name: PROPERTY6
columns.description: Additional property field for expansion.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_JSON
columns.description: Structured JSON content describing the event specific user preference overrides top of application level defaults.

columns.name: PROCESSING_STAGE
columns.description: The processing phase of this notification.

columns.name: CONTEXTS_JSON
columns.description: Structured JSON object capturing the contextual information for dispatch and processing.

columns.name: ANALYTICS_JSON
columns.description: Structured JSON object capturing the telemetrics related to the notification.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
